name: Wet Job

angles.text: As an engineer, you can admire the dwarven ingenuity behind a dependable emergency stockpile hidden in rugged terrain.
As a dwarf, you can take pride in the enduring quality of the mountain craft praised when the cache is recovered.
As a rogue, you know the value of hidden emergency stashes, kept ready in case a hasty flight is needed.

aliases: what kind of quest is wet job
faq.answer: You recover a hidden emergency stash, prepared with supplies for a hasty escape.
faq.q: What is the quest Wet Job about?

faq.answer: Someone left the stash as an emergency reserve in case they had to flee in a hurry. It holds a messenger bag with parchment and supplies, made with dwarven craft.
The stash lies high on a mountainside, at an eagle's nest on the rock face described as carved from the waterfalls of time. A messenger bag is partly buried there.
The buried messenger bag holds provisions and parchment, protected by dwarven craft.
faq.q: What is found in the messenger bag?

aliases: why is it called wet job
faq.answer: The name refers to the mountain landmarks, with waterfalls of time and damp soil around the hidden bag.
faq.q: Why is the task called Wet Job?

faq.answer: The cache's construction and reliability show dwarven engineering, made to withstand burial outdoors.

sections.body: In dangerous country, a reserve can make a quick escape possible. You search the rugged heights for a stash someone left there in case plans went wrong. Its supplies are waiting to be recovered.
sections.title: An Emergency Cache

sections.body: The directions lead to a high mountain perch, described as carved from the waterfalls of time. There, at the eagle's nest, a weathered messenger bag lies partly buried in the earth. Inside, provisions and parchment have endured beneath the soil, protected by dwarven craft.
sections.title: The Eagle's Nest

summary: On a mountainside, Wet Job sends you to recover an emergency reserve stash. Someone prepared it for a hasty escape and hid it near a high cliffside perch.
